body:
## GADGET — archival retention and expanded next-app collection

INSTRUCTION-ID: MSE-LIVE-PILOT-PREP-20261121-04 r1. Chad selected archival retention and explicitly asks GADGET to choose high-value data types beyond HR/HRV and implement them in the next app build. This adds source/build preparation alongside ongoing startup/CI/reproduction task -03, which remains active. No current live upload, phone install, new route or server deployment is inferred. Build a reviewable signed candidate and compatible archival schema/API path; use synthetic fixtures for tests. Preserve collector and accepted archive evidence. Backups/restores remain DEFERRED; archival retention is a retention policy, not a backup claim. No main merge or LLM forwarding.

Selected next-build read scope: heart rate; HRV SDNN; resting heart rate; walking heart-rate average; respiratory rate; oxygen saturation; sleeping wrist temperature; step count; walking/running distance; active energy; basal energy; Apple exercise time; sleep-analysis intervals/stages; workout summary (type, start/end, duration, recorded distance/energy when present). These provide cardiovascular, overnight/recovery and activity context. Read only available/authorized HealthKit samples; no invented zeros, synthetic filling or derived RMSSD from SDNN. Keep sleep categories distinct and preserve overlapping/source-specific records; no naive sum/dedup across sources. Preserve quantity aggregation semantics and units. Optional device/OS-unavailable types must not block core types or permission onboarding. No GPS/workout route, ECG/waveforms, reproductive data, contacts or arbitrary metadata export.

Archival semantics: retain accepted originals and source/revision lineage without an automatic age-based purge; retain upload receipts, schema versions and processing provenance. Record HealthKit deletion/replacement as explicit revisions/tombstones so the current view excludes deleted samples while archive history remains auditable. Explain that deleting a sample in Health does not itself erase an already archived copy; explicit archive deletion remains a separate user action/policy. Retain only the selected exported fields; scoped pseudonymous subject and source/device descriptors as needed, no user name, device serial or unrestricted metadata. Private raw archive remains potentially identifying, not anonymous. Collection stop, 48-hour pilot cutoff and archival retention are separate controls. Pilot start/backfill window and real-data activation remain for subsequent explicit launch scope.

ORACLE owns next app source/build: inspect actual collector and extend read permissions/type adapters/persistent incremental queries/anchors and local archive representation for the selected list, preserving current HR/HRV state and existing collector. Connect real-sample transformation to a durable live outbox with stable batch identity and receipt-only dequeue, but live transmission DISABLED by default until separately activated. Keep synthetic and real paths/scopes distinct. Add clear per-type availability/empty/unknown states and last-collected/queued/acknowledged timestamps. Support partial permissions, category/workout shapes, revision/deletion, restart/offline/retry, bounded batches/backpressure. No background delivery success claim from host tests. Review actual background entitlement/query lifecycle and document what still needs physical testing. Produce tested signed next-build artifact and source/product pin through existing preservation workflow; do not install yet.

ATLAS freezes additive versioned metric/category/workout wire and archival retention contract, with exact units, source timestamps and provenance, deletion/current-view semantics, availability and cumulative quantity overlap caveats. Keep frozen synthetic0.2 compatible; don't shoehorn categories into quantities. FORGE implements necessary server/schema/export adapters in a distinct candidate, no unreviewed migration/deployment, with synthetic end-to-end fixtures for every selected shape. Existing -03 CI cleanup remains first priority prerequisite. NICKY independently verifies next-build collector-state migration and all-type synthetic collection→outbox→normalized archive/export/reopen, without touching phone/current runtime. SENTINEL reviews minimal data scope/logging/access and archive-retention/deletion behavior, remains owner for -03 startup review. PROVENANCE binds selected fields/type mapping/source/revision/deletion to full export rows and signed artifact, with no health values in public records. PHOENIX continues -03 startup/reproduction first and reports 48-hour route/cert/grant/storage requirements read-only; do not renew/reopen. LONESTAR tracks compatible -03/-04 sequencing and source/build vs device/live activation separately.

Acceptance: tested next-build candidate with selected HealthKit types and preservation/migration evidence; independently verified additive archive schema/view/export and synthetic lineage; clear per-type availability and archive retention wording; default-off live transfer. Report actual implemented/deferred types individually and exact launch prerequisites. No clinical baseline interpretation or uninterrupted real-time guarantee.
